title: Calendar events and screenshot OCR
summary: Rocky can now create Google Calendar events and read text from screenshots attached to Slack messages.

sections.heading: New
items: Rocky can create Google Calendar events for reminders and schedule delegated decisions
Screenshots attached to Slack messages are read via OCR so Rocky can respond to visual content

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Document classification now correctly splits house vs estate statements
Empty model replies are retried instead of posting 'No response.'
